title: Networking Doesn’t Have to Be Awkward: 5 Simple Strategies That Actually Work!
description:
Networking feels awkward for a lot of people, especially when it feels forced, fake, or transactional. If you’ve ever left a networking event thinking “that was uncomfortable”, you’re not alone.

In this video, I share 5 practical networking strategies that make networking feel more natural, less awkward, and actually effective. These are real-world approaches I’ve used (and taught others) to build genuine professional relationships without small talk, scripts, or pretending to be someone you’re not.

You’ll learn:

How to network without feeling awkward or weird

How to build connections without “selling yourself”

How to make networking easier, especially if you hate it

These networking tips work whether you are:

Job searching

Changing careers

Growing your professional network

Introverted, anxious, or just tired of networking, feeling uncomfortable

If you want networking advice that actually works in real life, this video will help you feel more confident, more natural, and more effective when connecting with others.

 Subscribe @kirchnercareers for practical career advice, job search strategies, and networking tips that make things easier, not more awkward.
